CMBW terrain analysis

An attempt to identify the tileset data StarDraft 2 needs to generate ISOM terrain from the CMBW Prerelease brush sets: for each terrain, which tiles of the game’s border were found in its set and which were not. Built on assumptions; it can be wrong.

tile found in the set   not found  ·  hover a part for its ids  ·  2026-10-26

14 sets not shown

Dirt-Dirt2-cliff (Badlands), Dirt-Dirt3-cliff (Badlands), Dirtcliff-Grass1 (Badlands), Dirtcliff-mud1 (Badlands), Mud-Dirt2-Edge (Badlands), Urban-Halfsphalt-2 (Badlands), Cliff-Dirt-3 (Platform), Organ-Cliff-Flesh-1 (Platform), Basilica-cliff-crushedrock3 (Ash World), Highdirt-Higherdirtcliff (Jungle), Jungle-Rjungle-cliff (Jungle), Jungle-Rjungle-high-cliff (Jungle), RaisedJungle-Edge-Dirt-2 (Jungle), Flagstones-dirt3 (Twilight)
